description: Business validation rules for camt.052.001.10 (Bank to Customer Account Report - Interim)

rules.suggestion: Entry amount must be greater than zero. Use the CdtDbtInd field to indicate credit or debit direction.
examples: Invalid: <Amt Ccy="EUR">-500.00</Amt> (use positive amount with DBIT indicator)

rules.description: Entry amount must respect currency decimal precision
rules.suggestion: Ensure the number of decimal places matches the currency's standard precision. For example, USD/EUR use 2 decimals, JPY uses 0 decimals, BHD uses 3 decimals.

rules.description: Value date must not be in the future
rules.suggestion: Value date should typically be today or in the past for interim reports. Future value dates may be valid for expected transactions but should be verified.

rules.description: Report creation timestamp must not be in the future
rules.suggestion: Report creation date/time should be the current timestamp or earlier. Future timestamps are not valid.

rules.description: Entry currency code must be a valid ISO 4217 currency code
rules.suggestion: Ensure the currency code is a valid 3-letter ISO 4217 code such as USD, EUR, GBP, JPY.

rules.description: Account IBAN must be valid when present
rules.suggestion: IBAN must follow ISO 13616 format with valid country code and Mod-97 check digits.

rules.description: Report identification must be present and non-empty
rules.suggestion: Report ID is mandatory and must uniquely identify this interim account report.

rules.description: Entry reference must be present for each entry
rules.suggestion: Each entry must have a unique reference for tracking and reconciliation purposes.
Account identification (IBAN or other ID) must be specified to identify which account this report covers.

rules.description: Total debit entry count must match actual debit entries when present
rules.suggestion: The total debit entry count in TxsSummary must match the actual number of debit entries in the report.

rules.description: Total credit entry count must match actual credit entries when present
rules.suggestion: The total credit entry count in TxsSummary must match the actual number of credit entries in the report.

rules.description: Total debit sum must match sum of all debit entry amounts when present
rules.suggestion: The total debit sum in TxsSummary must equal the sum of all debit entry amounts in the report.

rules.description: Total credit sum must match sum of all credit entry amounts when present
rules.suggestion: The total credit sum in TxsSummary must equal the sum of all credit entry amounts in the report.
